runner:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
control=$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")")
root=$(dirname "$control")
repo=/home/ativaro/Documents/tide
stamp() { perl -MTime::HiRes=clock_gettime,CLOCK_MONOTONIC -e 'printf("%.9f\n",clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC))'; }
cd "$root/project"
while read -r bug rep arm; do
 ctl="$control/$bug"
 lang=${arm%-*}
 mode=name
 run="$root/results/$bug-$rep-$arm"
 mkdir "$run"
 find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -delete
 cp "$root/seeds/$bug/$arm"/* .
 ln -s "$ctl/verify" verify
 date -u +%FT%T.%NZ > "$run/utc"
 stamp > "$run/start"
 if ./verify > "$run/before"; then exit 10; else [[ $? == 1 ]]; fi
 jq -e '.failed > 0' "$run/before" >/dev/null
 obs=$(cat "$run/before")
 if [[ $lang == tide ]]; then
    args=$("$control/tide-args" summary.tide "$obs" "$run/checked")
    printf '%s\n' "$args" > "$run/input"
    "$repo/tide" run "$repo/workbench/project_context.tide" --inputs "$args" > "$run/packet"
 else
    for file in *.py; do jq -n --arg file "$file" --rawfile source "$file" '{file:$file,source:$source}'; done |
       jq -cs --arg observation "$obs" '{observation:$observation,files:.}' > "$run/packet"
 fi
 protocol="$control/instructions"
 schema="$control/schema"
 if [[ $mode == name ]]; then
   protocol="$control/instructions-name"; schema="$control/schema-name"
   if [[ $lang == tide ]]; then
     "$control/forms" summary.tide "$run/input" > "$run/forms"
     view=$(jq -c --slurpfile forms "$run/forms" '.+{forms:$forms[0]}' "$run/packet")
     "$repo/tide" run "$repo/workbench/function_body.tide" --call repair_view --inputs "$view" > "$run/grouped"
     mv "$run/grouped" "$run/packet"
     jq -r .instruction "$run/packet" > "$run/guide"
     catalog=$(jq -nc --slurpfile forms "$run/forms" --slurpfile checked "$run/checked" '{reachable_names:[$forms[0][].name],signatures:($checked[0].definitions|to_entries|map({name:.key,kind:.value.kind,signature:([.key]+[.value.params|to_entries[]|.key+":"+.value]+[">",.value.returns]|join(" "))}))}')
     "$repo/tide" run "$repo/workbench/project_context.tide" --call unused_signatures --inputs "$catalog" |
       jq -r 'if length>0 then "Other checked functions:",.[] else empty end' >> "$run/guide"
   else
     cp "$control/python-guide" "$run/guide"
   fi
 fi
 { cat "$ctl/task"; echo; cat "$protocol"; if [[ $mode == name ]]; then cat "$run/guide"; fi; echo; jq -r '.observation, (.files|sort_by(.file)[]| "\n--- "+.file+" ---\n"+.source)' "$run/packet"; } > "$run/prompt"
 stamp > "$run/ready"
 for attempt in 1 2 3; do
   a="$run/$attempt"
   mkdir "$a"
   cp "$run/prompt" "$a/prompt"
   if (( attempt>1 )); then
     echo 'The last proposal did not pass. Below are your previous proposal and the acceptance diagnostic. Start from the original sources above, and give the full corrected edit set.' >> "$a/prompt"
     cat "$run/$((attempt-1))/feedback" >> "$a/prompt"
   fi
   rc=0
   timeout 180s codex exec --ignore-user-config --disable memories --disable hooks --disable plugins --enable skip_host_skill_discovery --ephemeral --skip-git-repo-check -s read-only -m gpt-6-astra -c 'model_reasoning_effort="xhigh"' -c 'service_tier="priority"' -C "$PWD" --output-schema "$schema" --output-last-message "$a/answer" --json - < "$a/prompt" > "$a/events" 2> "$a/stderr" || rc=$?
   stamp > "$a/answered"
   echo "$rc" > "$a/process_status"
   mkdir "$a/candidate"
   cp "$root/seeds/$bug/$arm"/* "$a/candidate/"
   if [[ $rc == 0 ]] && (cd "$a/candidate" && "$control/apply" "$a/answer" "$arm" "$run" && "$ctl/verify") > "$a/acceptance" 2> "$a/diagnostic"; then
     stamp > "$run/end"
     echo passed > "$run/status"
     break
   fi
   { test ! -f "$a/answer" || cat "$a/answer"; echo; test ! -f "$a/acceptance" || cat "$a/acceptance"; test ! -f "$a/diagnostic" || cut -c1-1000 "$a/diagnostic" | head -20; if [[ $rc != 0 ]]; then echo "CLI exit $rc"; fi; } > "$a/feedback"
 done
 if [[ ! -f "$run/status" ]]; then stamp > "$run/end"; echo unresolved > "$run/status"; fi
 printf '%s %s\n' "$(basename "$run")" "$(cat "$run/status")"
done < "$control/order"
verify:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
control=$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")")
cases="$control/cases.json"
batches=$(jq -c 'map(.input)' "$cases")
if [[ -f summary.tide ]]; then
    actual=$(/home/ativaro/Documents/tide/tide run summary.tide --inputs "{\"batches\":$batches}")
else
    actual=$(python3 -B -c 'import sys,json; from summary import main; print(json.dumps(main(json.load(sys.stdin))))' <<< "$batches")
fi
jq -cen --slurpfile cases "$cases" --argjson actual "$actual" '
    $cases[0] as $cases |
    if (($actual | type) != "array" or ($actual | length) != ($cases | length)) then error("wrong number of summaries") else
        [range($cases|length) as $i | select($actual[$i] != $cases[$i].expect) | {input:$cases[$i].input, expected:$cases[$i].expect, actual:$actual[$i]}] as $fail |
        {passed:(($cases|length)-($fail|length)), failed:($fail|length), first_failure:($fail[0] // null)}
    end' | { read -r result; echo "$result"; jq -e '.failed == 0' <<< "$result" >/dev/null; }
apply:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
answer=$1
arm=$2
run=$3
control=$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")")
if [[ $arm == *-text ]]; then exec "$control/apply-text" "$answer" "${arm%-*}"; fi
if [[ $arm == python-* ]]; then exec python3 -B "$control/apply-named-py" "$answer"; fi
repo=/home/ativaro/Documents/tide
args=$(jq -nc --slurpfile args "$run/input" --slurpfile forms "$run/forms" --slurpfile reply "$answer" '{files:$args[0].units, forms:$forms[0], edits:$reply[0].edits}')
candidate=$("$repo/tide" run "$repo/workbench/function_body.tide" --call candidate_files --inputs "$args")
for file in *.tide; do jq -ejr --arg file "$file" '.[]|select(.file==$file)|.source' <<< "$candidate" > "$file"; done
text_patch:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
answer=$1
lang=$2
case "$lang" in tide) suffix=tide ;; python) suffix=py ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac
jq -e '.edits | type=="array" and length>0' "$answer" >/dev/null
while IFS= read -r edit; do
    file=$(jq -er '.file' <<< "$edit")
    [[ $file =~ ^[a-z]+\.$suffix$ && -f $file && ! -L $file ]]
    candidate=$(mktemp)
    jq -eRrsj --argjson edit "$edit" '
      if ($edit.old|length)==0 then error("empty match") else
        split($edit.old) | if length==2 then join($edit.replacement) else error("old text must occur exactly once") end
      end' "$file" > "$candidate"
    cat "$candidate" > "$file"
    rm -- "$candidate"
done < <(jq -c '.edits[]' "$answer")
compiler_forms:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
entry=$1
graph_input=$2
repo=${TIDE_PROJECT_ROOT:-/home/ativaro/Documents/tide}
cli="$repo/tide"
names=$("$cli" run "$repo/workbench/project_context.tide" --call reachable --inputs "$(jq -c '{root,graph}' "$graph_input")")
jq -r '.[]' <<< "$names" | while IFS= read -r name; do
  context=$("$cli" context "$entry" --function "$name")
  if [[ $(jq -r .kind <<< "$context") == rule ]]; then continue; fi
  node=$(jq -er '.nodes[0].node' <<< "$context")
  file=$(basename -- "$entry")
  if [[ $node == *:*:* ]]; then file=${node%:*:*}; fi
  "$cli" context "$entry" --function "$name" --node "$node" |
    jq -c --arg file "$file" '{name:.definition,$file,body:.selection.expanded}'
done | jq -sc .
checked_input:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
entry=$1
obs=$2
tide=/home/ativaro/Documents/tide/tide
dir=$(dirname -- "$entry")
checked=$("$tide" check "$entry")
printf '%s\n' "$checked" > "$3"
{ basename -- "$entry"; jq -r '.modules[]' <<< "$checked"; } |
while IFS= read -r file; do
  jq -n --arg file "$file" --rawfile source "$dir/$file" '{file:$file,source:$source}'
done |
jq -cs --arg observation "$obs" --argjson checked "$checked" '{root:"main", $observation, graph:($checked.definitions|to_entries|map({name:.key,calls:.value.calls})),units:.}'
